# Why Local-First AI Agents Matter

Privacy, ownership, and zero marginal cost. Local agents keep your code on your machine and learn without shipping your context to a third party.

## The case

A local-first agent runs models on your hardware, stores memory in files you can read, and talks to third-party APIs only through profiles you configured. Nothing about your workspace leaves unless a tool you enabled says so.

## When cloud still wins

Largest frontier models on the hardest reasoning. Route those steps to a cloud backend and keep the loop local.
